row.notes: Early-outs false when a signed config byte (per-id table at cfg+0x228 or default +0xe6e/+0x252) is >= 0. If self+0xb8 not set: resizes pointer vector +0x28..+0x38 to the vehicle count (vector at (+0xb0)+0x28), then per vehicle calls Ai_CarProfile_ResolveNames on the 0x6780-stride array at (+0x98)->+0x1a8->+0xad8, hashes the profile name (case-folded DJB2, seed 0x1505) and searches the map at +0x58/+0x60 for an entry with +0x80 == hash, storing it in +0x28[idx]. Also fetches the vehicle k_Sess_TyreComponentType component and calls Game_LapStats_RecordVehicleLap(comp+0x9bd0). Sets +0xb8 = all entries resolved and returns it. Good hook to see which tyre wear scale entry each car gets.
